headline: CHW @ MIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHW 4.51 at MIN 3.69, with a projected total of 8.20. Pitching context: Davis Martin has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Chase Meidroth, Kody Clemens, Byron Buxton, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags James Outman because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
